prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached adult reference image as mandatory identity and interior source, create a balanced 2x2 grid of four photorealistic fashion-editorial portraits. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, age presentation, hairstyle, wardrobe logic, and key traits across every panel. Use complementary wide-angle views: seated, standing, and mirror-reflection variations within a quiet modern room with a chair, warm wood flooring, a mirror, and minimal magazines. Use perspective only to reveal the room and pose dynamism; keep feet, hands, and all body proportions natural without close foreground emphasis. Light with soft direct flash plus warm interior ambient fill for crisp detail and controlled shadows. Preserve any source text only if clearly present; otherwise no text, logo, or watermark.
